name: Ariel Schön
biography: Ariel Schön is an experienced security researcher with unique experience in embedded and IoT security as well as vulnerability research. Ariel is a veteran of the IDF Intelligence Corps, where he served in research and management positions. Currently, he is consuming caffeine and doing security research at JSOF.
